title: BEST AUTOFARM
features:
- Auto Orb Farming – Collect selected orbs automatically in your current or manually chosen areas, with adjustable delay and batch multipliers.

- Instant Orb Claim – Trigger a bulk claim of selected orbs on demand.

- Auto Hoops – Teleports all hoops directly to your character’s position (and restores them when disabled).

- Area Teleports – Instantly teleport to any game area via the dynamic area list.

- Race Teleports – Teleport directly to the finish line of any race map.

- Auto Crystal Hatching – Continuously open a specific crystal of your choice.

- Smart Item Hatching – Search for a specific pet or trail; the script automatically uses the best crystal with the highest chance for that item.

- Auto Quests – Automatically claim completed quest rewards every few seconds, or manually claim them once.

- Auto Rebirth – Continuously rebirth with a fully adjustable time delay.

- Auto Free Gifts – Claim all available free gifts (1–8) automatically.

- Auto Fortune Wheel – Automatically spin the fortune wheel repeatedly.

- Feedback & Suggestion System – Send bug reports, ratings (1–5 stars), and feature ideas directly to the developer via an in-game form.
